mapper.insert: insert into "h_churn_result" (model_id, churn_rate, top1_reason, top2_reason, top3_reason) values (#{modelId}, #{churnRate}, #{top1Reason}, #{top2Reason}, #{top3Reason})
mapper.select:
select r.result_id, r.model_id, r.churn_rate, r.top1_reason, r.top2_reason, r.top3_reason from "h_churn_result" r
join "h_model_data" m ON r.model_id = m.model_id join "h_member" mem ON m.username = mem.username where mem.gym_id = #{gymId}

choose.when: select to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') as period, cast(round(avg(total_members)) as int) as totalMembers, cast(round(avg(risk_members)) as int) as riskMembers, avg(avg_churn_rate) as avgChurnRate from "h_churn_gym_daily" where gym_id = #{gymId} group by to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') order by period desc
choose.otherwise: select to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as period, total_members as totalMembers, risk_members as riskMembers, avg_churn_rate as avgChurnRate from "h_churn_gym_daily" where gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ( select to_char(max(stat_date), 'YYYY-MM') from "h_churn_gym_daily" where gym_id = #{gymId} ) order by stat_date desc

choose.when: select s.stat_type as statType, s.stat_key as statKey, cast(sum(s.member_count) as int) as memberCount, round(avg(s.member_count * 100.0 / nullif(g.risk_members,0)), 1) as pct from "h_churn_stat_daily" s join "h_churn_gym_daily" g on s.gym_id = g.gym_id and s.stat_date = g.stat_date where g.gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(g.stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{period} group by s.stat_type, s.stat_key order by s.stat_type, pct desc
choose.otherwise: select s.stat_type as statType, s.stat_key as statKey, s.member_count as memberCount, round(s.member_count * 100.0 / nullif(g.risk_members,0), 1) as pct from "h_churn_stat_daily" s join "h_churn_gym_daily" g on s.gym_id = g.gym_id and s.stat_date = g.stat_date where g.gym_id = #{gymId} and g.stat_date = cast(#{period} as date) order by s.stat_type, pct desc

choose.when: with cur as ( select distinct username from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{period} ), prev as ( select distinct username from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ( select max(to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM')) from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') < #{period} ) ) select c.username as username, mem.name as name, r.churn_rate as churnRate, r.top1_reason as top1Reason, r.top2_reason as top2Reason, r.top3_reason as top3Reason from cur c join "h_member" mem on c.username = mem.username join "h_model_data" md on c.username = md.username join "h_churn_result" r on md.model_id = r.model_id where c.username not in (select username from prev) order by r.churn_rate desc
choose.otherwise: with cur as ( select distinct username from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and stat_date = cast(#{period} as date) ), prev as ( select distinct username from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and stat_date = ( select max(stat_date) from "h_churn_stat_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and stat_date < cast(#{period} as date) ) ) select c.username as username, mem.name as name, r.churn_rate as churnRate, r.top1_reason as top1Reason, r.top2_reason as top2Reason, r.top3_reason as top3Reason from cur c join "h_member" mem on c.username = mem.username join "h_model_data" md on c.username = md.username join "h_churn_result" r on md.model_id = r.model_id where c.username not in (select username from prev) order by r.churn_rate desc

mapper.select: select mem.username as username, mem.name as name, r.churn_rate as churnRate from "h_member" mem join "h_model_data" md on mem.username = md.username join "h_churn_result" r on md.model_id = r.model_id where mem.gym_id = #{gymId} and lower(mem.role) = 'member' order by r.churn_rate desc
select username, name, email from "h_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and role = 'trainer' order by name
